integrity: The complete eight-page original Selkov article was inspected at the kinetic reduction, normalized positive model, unique equilibrium, phase portrait, and self-oscillation analysis; targeted full-document searches found no conditional, average, or moment formulation and no statistical variance statement. The complete public Brechmann–Rendall text was inspected at the exact dimensionless equations, Hopf calculation, Poincare compactification, global bounded-solution alternatives, and unbounded-solution analysis; full-document searches found no conditional, variance, average, or moment formulation. Published semantic searches covered invariant measures, reaction-flux conditioning, stationary covariance, derivative-energy identities, reciprocal moments, and equilibrium-level crossings. The two conditional laws, activity decomposition, strict Jensen inequalities, equality classification, and crossing theorem were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes compact invariant support strictly inside the positive quadrant.
It does not apply to the known unbounded Selkov trajectories.
It determines conditional means and selected second-order statistics rather than the full invariant distribution or period.
The equilibrium and periodic-orbit existence theory is prior work and is explicitly excluded from the originality claim.
An equivalent short weighted generator identity could remain in older unindexed glycolysis literature.
title: Dual stationary conditional laws and equilibrium-straddling in the Selkov oscillator
